task_text: I have a video call starting in 5 minutes. My desk area needs to look presentable and I should be able to see and hear clearly. The bedroom light is off.

central_instructions.R3: Prepare any light objects in the bedroom that need to be passed to R4 for organizing the desk area.
central_instructions.R4: Organize the desk area in the bedroom to make it presentable and ensure the light is turned on for the video call.
